svg.title: Permanganate oxidative alkene cleavage: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: CH3CH=CHCH3 + MnO4− → Cyclic manganate-derived adduct. Oxidant addition introduces two C–O linkages through a cyclic manganese-containing model; manganese speciation is not fixed by a four-digit code.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Oxidant addition introduces two C–O linkages through a cyclic manganese-containing model; manganese
speciation is not fixed by a four-digit code.
